bullets: Instead of using X_i (of dimension d) use \phi(X_i) (with higher dimension )
Instead of using \phi(X_i)^T \phi(X_j) use K(X_i^T , X_j) (Where K is one of kernel functions)
labels: (Where K is one of kernel functions)
equations: b = -\frac{1}{2} [\max_{i: y_i=-1} W^T X_i + \min_{i: y_i=+1} W^T X_i]
Class of vector Z \Rightarrow sign(W^T Z + b)

Main content inside a large bordered rectangle divided into three horizontal stacked bands: top band shows original SVM formulation with a wide equation box, two side-by-side formula boxes (W and b), and an orange classification box below; middle band shows 'Remember:' section with 'Mapping' and 'Kernelization' rows containing text and inline equations; bottom band shows kernelized SVM formulation mirroring the top band but with green oval highlights on kernel terms. All text left-aligned within bands.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with off-white background (#FDFBF7). 2. Add title 'How to Kernelize SVM' centered at top in large bold red text (#C0392B). 3. Add a yellow circle with '35' at top-right corner. 4. Draw a large bordered rectangle covering most of the slide. 5. In the top section inside the rectangle, insert the objective equation \mathscr{L}_D(\alpha) = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i - \frac{1}{2} \sum_{j=1}^N \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i \alpha_j y_i y_j X_i^T X_j spanning full width. 6. Below it, place two boxes side by side: left box with W = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i y_i X_i, right box with b = -\frac{1}{2} [\max_{i: y_i=-1} W^T X_i + \min_{i: y_i=+1} W^T X_i]. Use blue borders. 7. Below those, add an orange-filled box (#FDEBD0) with 'Class of vector Z => sign(W^T Z + b)'. 8. In the middle section, add 'Remember :' in blue italic. 9. Add 'Mapping' row: red italic 'Mapping', then text 'Instead of using X_i (of dimension d) use \phi(X_i) (with higher dimension )', then equation X_i^T X_j => \phi(X_i)^T \phi(X_j). 10. Add 'Kernelization' row: red italic 'Kernelization', then text 'Instead of using \phi(X_i)^T \phi(X_j) use K(X_i^T , X_j) (Where K is one of kernel functions)'. 11. In the bottom section, repeat the objective equation but circle/highlight X_i^T X_j with a green oval. 12. Repeat the W and b boxes side by side; in the b box, circle both W^T X_i terms with green ovals. 13. Repeat the orange classification box but circle W^T Z with a green oval. 14. Use sans-serif for body text, serif math font for equations. All text dark blue (#2C3E50) unless specified otherwise.
